name: Dino Experience
description: Travel back in time at this immersive digital exhibition. It uses virtual reality and 360º projections to bring the age of dinosaurs to vivid life.
longDescription:
The Dino Experience is a digital exhibition at Alfândega do Porto, running from May 21st to May 27th, 2026. This event focuses on the Mesozoic Era, presenting prehistoric life through advanced technological displays. It aims to educate and entertain by recreating ancient environments and their inhabitants using modern exhibition techniques.

Visitors will encounter a range of dinosaur species presented through virtual reality and 360-degree projections, designed to create an immersive environment. The experience is suitable for families and individuals interested in natural history and digital art. The Alfândega do Porto, a historic customs house on the Douro River, provides a grand and spacious setting for the large-scale projections.

Tickets are priced variably and are available for purchase. The Alfândega do Porto is accessible via bus routes and is a walkable distance from the Ribeira district. The venue is generally family-friendly, catering to a wide age range.
